_readme: The town kid. The other optional voice, and the only one that says out loud what is waiting
in the hollow - a player who skipped the warden can still learn it here.
Structure is unchanged: three chained nodes into a two-choice line, the first choice
requires_flag promised_elder and is HIDDEN rather than refused when it is not set. That is
the shape the dialog tests pin, so the rewrite keeps it exactly.

greet.speaker: Kid
greet.text: You're going west, aren't you. Everyone who goes west has that face.

brag.speaker: Kid
brag.text: There's a hollow past the village. Something lives down there and it NESTS things. That's when it sits on a thing so you can't have it.

boast.speaker: Kid
boast.text: The elder says you promised to go into the keep. Did you?

knew.speaker: Kid
knew.text: I KNEW it. I'm telling everyone. Take a light, it's dark in there, everyone knows that.
